3500.def:
// Memory dump primitive: python reading /proc/PID/mem (and usually /proc/PID/maps first)
let PythonProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where FileName matches regex @"^python[23]?$"
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Runner.Worker","/proc/","memdump.py","isSecret")
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId=tostring(ProcessId), ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let MemReads = DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where FolderPath startswith "/proc/" and FileName in~ ("mem","maps")
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex @"^python[23]?$"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessId=tostring(InitiatingProcessId), InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
MemReads
| join kind=inner (PythonProcs) on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine1
| order by Timestamp desc
3500.sent:
// Auditd path-watch on /proc/*/mem; requires audit rules: -w /proc -p r -k proc_read
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Facility =~ "auth" or ProcessName =~ "auditd" or SyslogMessage has "type=PATH"
| where SyslogMessage matches regex @"name=\x22?/proc/[0-9]+/(mem|maps)\x22?"
| where SyslogMessage matches regex @"comm=\x22?python[23]?\x22?"
| extend ProcPath = extract(@"name=\x22?(/proc/[0-9]+/(?:mem|maps))\x22?", 1, SyslogMessage)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, HostIP, ProcPath, SyslogMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc

| where Timestamp > ago(90d)

| order by Severity asc, Timestamp desc

        | project TimeGenerated, CsHost, CsMethod, CsUriStem, CsUriQuery, CIp, UserAgent, ScStatus, _ResourceId),

        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where DeviceProduct in~ ("WAF","ModSecurity","Imperva SecureSphere","F5 ASM","Azure WAF","Cloudflare")

        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, SourceIP, DestinationIP, RequestURL, RequestMethod, RequestClientApplication, _ResourceId))
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: c4a91bf2-78d6-4a83-9f1e-2b8d4c5e6f17
status: experimental
description: Detects a Java/Tomcat server process writing a .jsp/.jspx/.war file into a webapp-served directory (webapps, WEB-INF, ROOT, src/main/webapp), consistent with webshell drop after CVE-2023-50164 path-traversal exploitation. Excludes the legitimate Jasper JSP compilation cache (work\Catalina\) to control false positives.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/struts-path-traversal-vulnerability/
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-50164
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/23/l/decoding-cve-2023-50164--unveiling-the-apache-struts-file-upload.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - cve.2023.50164
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_process:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat10.exe'
      - '\prunsrv.exe'
  selection_target_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.jsp'
      - '.jspx'
      - '.war'
  selection_target_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\webapps\'
      - '\WEB-INF\'
      - '\ROOT\'
      - 'src\main\webapp'
  filter_jasper_cache:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\work\Catalina\'
      - '\jasper\'
  condition: selection_process and selection_target_ext and selection_target_path and not filter_jasper_cache
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate WAR deployments via Tomcat manager (compare against change-management window)
  - Application-build / CI agents that exploded a WAR into webapps for a real release
level: high
3559.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as proc values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.process_name="java.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="tomcat*.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="javaw.exe" OR Filesystem.process_name="java") (Filesystem.file_name="*.jsp" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.jspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.war") (Filesystem.file_path="*\\webapps\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\WEB-INF\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ROOT\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/webapps/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/WEB-INF/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*src/main/webapp/*") NOT Filesystem.file_path="*\\work\\Catalina\\*" NOT Filesystem.file_path="*/work/Catalina/*" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3559.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@Image:(*\java.exe OR *\Java.exe OR *\JAVA.EXE OR *\javaw.exe OR *\tomcat.exe OR *\tomcat9.exe OR *\tomcat10.exe OR *\prunsrv.exe)) (@TargetFilename:(*.jsp OR *.JSP OR *.jspx OR *.JSPX OR *.war OR *.WAR)) (@TargetFilename:(*\webapps\* OR *\WEB-INF\* OR *\ROOT\* OR *src\main\webapp*)) -@TargetFilename:(*\work\Catalina\* OR *\jasper\*)
3559.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| ContextImageFileName=/(java|javaw|tomcat\d*|prunsrv)\.exe$/i
| TargetFileName=/\.(jsp|jspx|war)$/i
| regex("(\\\\webapps\\\\|\\\\WEB-INF\\\\|\\\\ROOT\\\\|src\\\\main\\\\webapp|/webapps/|/WEB-INF/|/ROOT/|src/main/webapp)", field=TargetFileName)
| NOT regex("(\\\\work\\\\Catalina\\\\|/work/Catalina/|\\\\jasper\\\\|/jasper/)", field=TargetFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

3560.def:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("java.exe","javaw.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","prunsrv.exe","java")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh","nc","ncat","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","whoami.exe","whoami","net.exe","net1.exe","hostname.exe","ipconfig.exe","ifconfig","id")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
3560.sent:
// Covers both Windows (SecurityEvent 4688) and Linux (Syslog/auditd) Tomcat hosts.
(union isfuzzy=true
    (SecurityEvent
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where EventID == 4688
        | where ParentProcessName has_any ("java.exe","javaw.exe","tomcat.exe","tomcat9.exe","tomcat10.exe","prunsrv.exe")
        | extend NewProcLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
        | where NewProcLeaf in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","nc.exe","ncat.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","hostname.exe","ipconfig.exe")
        | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
        | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, _ResourceId),
    (ImProcessCreate
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ParentProcessName has_any ("java","javaw","tomcat","prunsrv")
        | extend ChildLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, iff(ActingProcessName has "/", "/", "\\"))[-1]))
        | where ChildLeaf in~ ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","nc","ncat","curl","wget","whoami","id","ifconfig","ip","hostname","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh")
        | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, _ResourceId))
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Tomcat/Java Process Spawns OS Shell or Download Utility (Post-Webshell RCE)
id: 5f7c2e88-9a4b-4c01-bd2e-e3a16b8c7d92
status: experimental
description: Detects a Java/Tomcat server process spawning cmd.exe, powershell.exe, /bin/sh, /bin/bash, nc, curl, wget, or recon LOLBins — indicating post-exploitation command execution via webshell after CVE-2023-50164 or any other Struts/Tomcat RCE.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/struts-path-traversal-vulnerability/
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-50164
  - https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/cve-2023-50164-apache-struts-vulnerability
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1190
  - cve.2023.50164
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'
      - '\javaw.exe'
      - '\tomcat.exe'
      - '\tomcat9.exe'
      - '\tomcat10.exe'
      - '\prunsrv.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\nc.exe'
      - '\ncat.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\hostname.exe'
      - '\ipconfig.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Application functionality that legitimately invokes a shell (rare — should be inventoried)

level: high

3561.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Command injection in Python: examples and prevention
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("backend.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/etc/shadow") or FileName in~ ("backend.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3561.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Command injection in Python: examples and prevention ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("backend.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/shadow*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("backend.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

title: Vulnerable React DevTools / Vue.js devtools Extension Folder File Write
id: 4f3a86b1-2d4c-4f4f-93b8-9b1eaa5b8c91
description: Detects file writes inside the React Developer Tools (CVE-2023-5654) or Vue.js devtools (CVE-2023-5718) browser extension folders, indicating the (potentially vulnerable) extension is installed and is being updated/loaded by a browser process.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/webextension-security-vulnerabilities-react-developer-tools-vue-js/
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-5654
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-5718
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.t1176
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ext_id:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\fmkadmapgofadopljbjfkapdkoienihi\'
      - '\nhdogjmejiglipccpnnnanhbledajbpd\'
      - '\react_devtools\'
      - '\vue-js-devtools\'
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\manifest.json'
      - '.js'
  selection_browser:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
  condition: selection_ext_id and selection_file and selection_browser
level: low

3569.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — File encryption in Python: An in-depth exploration of symmetric and asymmetric t
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("main.py", "sym.py", "asym.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("main.py", "sym.py", "asym.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3569.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — File encryption in Python: An in-depth exploration of symmetric and asymmetric t ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("main.py","sym.py","asym.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("main.py","sym.py","asym.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3576.sigma:
title: Curl SOCKS5 Hostname Resolution Invocation (CVE-2023-38545 Trigger Path)
id: 6d3a7a1c-4a3b-4f7e-9b2a-9a1e9f5c2c11
description: Detects curl invocations using SOCKS5 with remote hostname resolution, the precondition required to trigger the CVE-2023-38545 heap buffer overflow in libcurl 7.69.0 - 8.3.0.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/curl-high-severity-vulnerability-oct-2023/
  - https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2023-38545.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1203
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '/curl'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '--socks5-hostname'
      - 'socks5h://'
      - '-x socks5h'
      - '--proxy socks5h'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
level: medium
3576.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="curl.exe" OR Processes.process_name="curl") AND (Processes.process="*--socks5-hostname*" OR Processes.process="*socks5h://*" OR Processes.process="*-x socks5h*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

3597.sigma:
title: macOS Keyboard Text Replacements Dumped via defaults
id: 7d3a0f6e-1c5a-4e91-9c2c-1f3b8c2b5f10
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the macOS `defaults` CLI reading NSUserDictionaryReplacementItems, the global preference holding keyboard text replacements. Developers commonly bind sensitive snippets (passwords, SSH keys, credit-card numbers) to these macros, and the read can be triggered by any non-privileged process — including a malicious npm postinstall hook.
references:
    - https://snyk.io/blog/using-insecure-npm-package-manager-defaults/
    - https://www.yagiz.co/using-insecure-npm-defaults/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
    - attack.t1555
    - attack.t1059.004
    - attack.t1195.002
    - attack.credential_access
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: macos
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith: '/defaults'
    selection_cmd:
        CommandLine|contains: 'NSUserDictionaryReplacementItems'
    condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
    - System Preferences / Settings.app interacting with NSGlobalDomain (parent: cfprefsd, SystemUIServer)
    - Legitimate developer scripts that intentionally back up or sync text replacements
level: high
3597.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where Processes.os="macOS"
      AND Processes.process_name="defaults"
      AND Processes.process="*NSUserDictionaryReplacementItems*"
    by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| where parent_process_name!="cfprefsd" AND parent_process_name!="SystemUIServer"
